items.body: Due to a mixup on our end, some of you will need these tokens to complete today's Armageddon mission: The World Must Hold. Please use them today, as they've been given specifically for Armageddon. Fight on, Tacticians!

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friends at Tacticus Analytics!
items.body: Tacticus Analytics continues to grow, and more guilds are using its data to sharpen their raid planning. Thanks for the support, and enjoy the code.

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friends at Tacticus Planner!
items.body: Thanks for using the planner. Be sure to check out its Discord channel to stay up to date on all the new features, and please enjoy this small gift.

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friends at Raidman Replays!
items.body: A thank you from ATinCan for the 2,000 players using his Raidman replay viewer!  Please enjoy this gift!

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Nox!
items.body: You helped him hit his 8k milestone! Here's to speeding toward the next one! Please enjoy this token of his appreciation.

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Elhinaru!
items.body: He hopes you enjoy his combat card collection as much as you like this small token of his appreciation!
All we can say is...WAAAGH! Thanks to everyone who fought in the great Armageddon battles. We've learned a lot, and we hope you enjoyed it!

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend ZWaard!
items.body: Don't miss out on Blood Angels tips and tricks. Learn how to dominate Guild Wars and Tournament Arena in ZWaard's new video! Also, please enjoy this small gift of her appreciation!

items.title: Thanks for participating in the Armageddon Contests!
items.body: The people have spoken, and the Blood Angels beat out the Orks in Armageddon contests! Here are your spoils!

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Kraetor!
items.body: Check out his latest video, and please accept this small token of his appreciation!

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Historitor Mor
items.body: After a rough few weeks, she's grateful for all of your support and messages. She hopes you enjoy this small gift of her appreciation.

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friends at Ahriman App!
items.body: Ahriman now offers live Guild Raid damage leaderboards in Discord. Officers can use /leaderboards to set one up for their guild. We hope you enjoy the new feature as much as you enjoy this small gift.

items.title: Thank you for supporting our friends at SideQuest!
items.body: We hope you enjoy their video as much as this small token of their appreciation!
Our friend TimmyMan (Tacticus Analytics) got married! We don't need a spreadsheet to know this is amazing 😉

items.title: Thanks for being a part of our community!
items.body: What do you get when you cross 40k with uh..another 40k? Our incredible community! We're celebrating 80,000 members, and we're still growing. Next step? Take over all the known worlds. We can't wait to do this with you by our side!
It's the 4th Anniversary of Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus, and we're excited to celebrate with you. Thanks for a great four years and here's to forty thousand more!
There are widespread outages affecting many people, but we only care about _you_.

items.title: Thank you for visiting our friend Tabletop Tactics!
items.body: We hope you enjoyed their video. Here’s a little gift from them to you.

items.title: ¡Gracias por apoyar a nuestro amigo Nelshirai!
items.body: Agradece vuestro apoyo constante y espera que disfrutéis de su último vídeo. Por favor, aceptad este regalo como muestra de agradecimiento.

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Tactifuchs!
items.body: You helped him reach a big milestone! We hope you appreciate this small gift.
Footage thank you! And thank you for staying on it <3
Who the hell got your other three?

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Tactical Raven!
items.body: Check out his latest video with guest Terminus, and please enjoy this small gift on his behalf.

items.title: Thanks for supporting our friend Painhawk!
items.body: Check out Lucius the Eternal's mythic journey in Painhawk's latest video, and enjoy these shards for the Reanimator that will help your mechs.

items.body: We appreciate your patience while we sort out the server issues. Please accept this small token of our appreciation. See you soon in game!
